name: pair_device
description: Add/pair a physical device -- callable any time, including mid-Plan-session. Ask the customer what protocol (insteon, z-wave, zigbee, matter, x10) if unclear. Only 'insteon' is wired up right now; other protocols return a not-yet-supported message -- walk the customer through manual pairing instead. Action depends on protocol: add_by_address (insteon/x10 only) is for a device whose own address the customer already knows or can read off the unit. start_inclusion/finish_inclusion (insteon/zwave/zigbee/matter) is for everything else -- start_inclusion puts the controller in pairing mode so the customer can activate one or more devices, finish_inclusion then commits everything included during that window (newly added devices won't have a name yet -- refresh the device list afterward to find and name them). For adding a marketplace plugin (not a physical device), use install_plugin/buy_plugin instead.

action.description: add_by_address is insteon/x10 only (needs device_address). start_inclusion/finish_inclusion works for insteon/zwave/zigbee/matter (finish_inclusion optionally takes flag).

device_address.description: The device's own physical address -- required for action=add_by_address.

flag.description: Optional numeric flag for finish_inclusion (defaults to 1).
